title: mail-server: Email/set create threads only via inReplyTo/references convenience props
description: Found in JMAP-2o2i. build_email_from_create calls assign_thread with draft.in_reply_to / draft.references only. A create that sets header:In-Reply-To[:asMessageIds] or header:References instead gets a fresh thread although the stored message carries the field (RFC 8621 §3 threading). Fix: derive the thread lookup ids from the composed/parsed message (or the header: properties) rather than the convenience fields.
